premises.text: The password is a weak link in digital security due to human forgetfulness and negligence.
premises.evidence_span: that weak link is us. We are able to think, create and discover but we are also forgetful and at times negligent or even malicious.

premises.text: Over 86% of security breaches are caused by users.
premises.evidence_span: over 86% of breaches today are caused by users and not by hackers crackling on mechanical keyboards in the dark.

premises.text: Existing password management tools are not widely adopted due to complexity and integration requirements.
premises.evidence_span: none have been widely adopted mainly because they either require teaching the user something new or require integrations which take time, money and most importantly, a dedicated IT department.

premises.text: Current tools create a single point of failure by storing sensitive information in the cloud.
premises.evidence_span: All of these tools put your sensitive information in the cloud creating a single point of failure.

premises.text: MyKey allows users to manage access to digital workspaces without requiring integrations.
premises.evidence_span: everything that I've shown you today requires no integration with service providers and features can be turned on or off depending on the needs of your team.

premises.text: MyKey provides real-time visibility and control over user accounts for administrators.
premises.evidence_span: As the admin I have a real-time view of the portal gives me full visibility and control over users' accounts.

premises.text: MyKey can enforce location-based and time-based access rules.
premises.evidence_span: I can also set location-based rules on Priscilla's account. This rule allows me to geographically control where this account is accessed from.

premises.text: MyKey can automate password changes and manage account provisioning.
premises.evidence_span: I can also set a company-wide schedule for password changes.

value.text: MyKey simplifies and secures access management for teams.
value.evidence_span: security doesn't have to be something complicated, expensive, and time-consuming.
